quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Boozer is living up to the hype as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: Cam Boozer is absolutely living up to the exact billing
quotes.quote: Cam Boozer is absolutely living up to the exact billing. Even though Ty Jerome, who right now is battling a hip injury, they are actually missing two or three rotation players with injury right now. Ty Jerome has kind of gotten a lot of the attention because of his incredible scoring early in the season. There is a whole bunch of Grizzlies playing well, but Cam Boozer is, you know, despite still not shooting at the most high efficiency percentage, he is putting up just absolutely great performance after great performance. He would be my rookie of the year vote 15 games into the season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jazz, Wizards, and Nets failed to execute their 'flip' strategy
quotes.excerpt: they wanted to tank last year, but they also wanted to acquire veteran players who would flip
quotes.quote: They wanted to tank last year, but they also wanted to acquire veteran players who would flip them into contention. And so you had these teams losing immense amounts of games and holding in reserve these guys. If you look at the Jazz, they trade for Jaren Jackson midway through the year. They had Lauri Markkanen who they were holding down in terms of how many minutes he was actually getting. And the concept was they were going to flip this team. Now, they have had unfortunate injury circumstances, but it is not working out in Utah.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Wizards' 'flip' strategy has resulted in a poor record
quotes.excerpt: they get Trae Young and Anthony Davis, they get the number one pick. Now they're trying the flip
quotes.quote: They get Trae Young and Anthony Davis, they get the number one pick. Now they're trying the flip and they got off to a good start, but reality has come crashing down. They're 4 and 11. 15 games is a reasonable sample size. They're an outfit that is not performing to the level that they thought. They honestly, I think, saw themselves as a team that could sniff the top six and maybe they will, but that is not the way it is looking.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Mavericks are actively trying to trade Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: the Mavericks called a lot of teams trying to trade Anthony Davis
quotes.quote: The Mavericks called a lot of teams trying to trade Anthony Davis. Which affects the demand. Trust me, the Mavericks called a lot of teams trying to trade Anthony Davis.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers were right to offer Anthony Davis a max contract
quotes.excerpt: they had a reasonable belief that somebody else was going to offer him the max
quotes.quote: They had a reasonable belief that somebody else was going to offer him the max and offered him that max. Obviously, that was a risky decision and its first returns are not good. But I want to contrast that with a team like Charlotte. Charlotte last year was in the middle. They make the play-in. It was an unexpectedly good season. They looked at their team and had an organizational decision, we don't think that this team is going the right direction. We think we're headed for the middle. So they traded LaMelo Ball when his value was kind of high. They traded Miles Bridges and they loaded up on draft picks and pick swaps and things like that and said, okay, we're going to lean into the young draft picks and the other young draft picks they had and they knew they were probably going to take a step back.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's future with the Wizards remains uncertain
quotes.excerpt: whatever everyone's wanting to know is, are they going to trade him or not?
quotes.quote: Whatever everyone's wanting to know is, are they going to trade him or not? Now, the other thing that people are watching is if the Wizards contemplate a coaching change and whether or not this poor start will result in a coaching change. And if there's a coaching change, whether or not that would buy them a reset because they kind of said, let's look 20 to 30 games and okay, the AD side heard that, they can't force him into a contract or force him into a trade. And so AD has shown up and played. And so the question is, do the Wizards stick to that?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Phil Jackson wouldn't make the Wizards a winning team
quotes.excerpt: I think you can get Phil Jackson at his absolute peak to come to Washington
quotes.quote: I think you can get Phil Jackson at his absolute peak to come to Washington and they're still not going to be a winning team. That there's a big gap between where teams value him and the kind of numbers that he thinks he's worth. And again, this is the exact thing the Mavericks ran into and the Mavericks were able to unload some other salaries in that deal and say, we didn't get much in return, but we at least got off a bunch of money.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's $63 million player option is a major factor
quotes.excerpt: do we really believe that he is for sure not picking up his $63 million player option?
quotes.quote: Do we really believe that he is for sure not picking up his $63 million player option for next year? Because it's $63 million. It's a lot of money. And so the question is, do you enter into negotiations with Anthony Davis, whether you're the Wizards now or you're the team that wants to trade for him, and call a bluff that he will definitely opt out? I'm sure that's what his representation, which is Clutch, is going to say. Yeah, if you, if you don't agree to a deal with us, we're going to say goodbye. But do we really, really believe he's leaving $63 million?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch is doing an incredible coaching job with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: he thinks Chris Finch has been the coach, and I hate saying awards in November
quotes.quote: He thinks Chris Finch has been the coach, and I hate saying awards in November, but like, he's doing an incredible coaching job with this group. And he has a reputation of being a really good coach, but he's doing an incredible coaching job with this group. And while LaMelo's overall statistics, you know, are down from where he was a year ago, their numbers defensively when he is out there are good. They're great. I mean, they're great. They're elite.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels' leadership has been immense for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: his leadership has been immense. Like, he's a tough guy, he's a smart guy
quotes.quote: His leadership has been immense. Like, he's a tough guy, he's a smart guy, he's a team-first guy. And he's like, they're not going to be like some big long highlight reel, because he doesn't do spectacular things. He does simple things really well. His shooting, he's averaging almost 18 a game, shooting 52, 43, 91, and playing great defense. When you talk about the most impactful trades at last year's deadline, there were a lot of bigger names moved. There's nobody who's moved the needle more than Jaden McDaniels.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Murray deserves credit for his defensive improvement
